create.name: Dr. Richard Miller
create.bio:
Dr. Richard Miller is an American clinical psychologist and yogic scholar who has taught meditation for more than fifty years, drawing on Advaita Vedanta, Kashmir Shaivism, Tantra, Taoism and Buddhism and setting them beside Western psychology. He created Integrative Restoration, known as iRest, a modern form of the old yogic practice of yoga nidra, and founded the iRest Institute to train teachers in it. He also helped found the International Association of Yoga Therapists and was the first editor of its journal.

In recent years his own teaching has centred on nondual meditation, which he now offers through Explorations in Stillness. Its aim, as he frames it, is less self-improvement than recognising a wholeness that is already present beneath thought and effort, approached both directly and step by step through guided practice and self-inquiry. He leads year-long online study groups, silent and residential retreats in California and further afield, and a self-paced course on pranayama for yoga teachers and practitioners. His books with Sounds True include Yoga Nidra: The Meditative Heart of Yoga and a revised edition built around the iRest method, and his guided practices are widely shared on Insight Timer.

books.title: Yoga Nidra: The Meditative Heart of Yoga
books.author: Richard Miller
books.description: His first Sounds True book on yoga nidra, presenting the practice as a path of self-inquiry rooted in nondual teaching rather than only a relaxation method. It comes with guided recordings.

books.title: Yoga Nidra: The iRest Meditative Practice for Deep Relaxation and Healing
books.author: Richard Miller
books.description: A revised edition of his yoga nidra guide, rebuilt around the stages of the iRest method. It leads readers through the practice step by step towards resting in their essential nature.

books.title: Resting in Stillness: Integrative Restoration - iRest Yoga Nidra
books.author: Richard Miller
books.description: An earlier, shorter guide to the iRest form of yoga nidra published by Anahata Press. It sets out the practice and the thinking behind it.

The iRest Institute site is largely sold on conditions (pages on depression, anxiety, chronic pain, trauma, sleep, military settings); his own site Explorations in Stillness is centred on nondual meditation, so he is listed on that basis. A human may want to confirm.

No offerings: every dated retreat on his calendar has passed, the 2026-27 year-long course began on 26 Feb 2026, and the Breathing for Life course was left out (see left_out). Listing rests on videos, books and Insight Timer.
Videos are from other channels where he is the sole speaker: Science and Nonduality, Indica Yoga, Stanford Contemplation by Design, Deconstructing Sentience.
